description: ML-DSA-signed head {seq, root, sig} of the append-only log that binds every mailbox record (slot|meta|kemPub|ts). Signed by the SAME issuer key as null_prov_issuer. Keep the last head you saw; a later head must extend it (null_witness_range) - a fork is proof of equivocation. Public on every lane so third-party auditors see the same log.
name: null_witness_head
title: NULL transparency - signed head of the mailbox binding log
